**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000 USD  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $1 050 000 USD  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (latest quarterly report, Q1 2024)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau – American Community Survey, 2023 5‑year estimates  
> • California Association of Realtors – Market Snapshot, 2024  

> **Note:**  
> • The *median* figure ($800k) represents the middle value of all sold homes and is commonly cited as the “average” price in media reports.  
> • The *mean* figure ($1.05M) is higher because a small number of very expensive properties pull the average upward.  

If you need a more precise figure for a specific county or city, let me know!
